headline: Diljit DOSANJH 🏟️ Makes HISTORY 📖 Under WEMBLEY 🏛️ Arch
text:
Under the WORLD 🌍 famous WEMBLEY 🏟️ arch on SATURDAY 🌃 night the five 🕔 words rang out PUNJABI 🏏 Aa Gaye Wembley OYE 🎉 as Indian 🕌 megastar DILJIT 🧿 Dosanjh kicked off his landmark GIG 🎤 by tweaking his usual catchphrase that the PUNJABIS 🐂 have ARRIVED 🚪 this time it was a PLAYFUL 🃏 twist because DILJIT 🧿 Daddy is now the FIRST 🥇 ever Punjabi singer to HEADLINE 📢 Wembley Stadium the music venue CONFIRMED 📜 after addressing his FANS 👥 he reflected that this MOMENT ⏰ will go down in the HISTORY 📖 books and as BHANGRA 🥁 beats blared the CROWD 🤘 erupted with CHEERS 🗣️ while he launched into his BIGGEST 📈 hits from Born to Shine 🌟 to Lover ❤️ over two DECADES ⏳ Diljit has built a HUGE 🌎 global fanbase topping CHARTS 📊 and singing with the likes of ED 🧔 Sheeran he has even BUSTED 💃 Bhangra moves with Jimmy Fallon the US talk show host who labelled him the BIGGEST 🏆 Punjabi artist on the PLANET 🌍 and this Wembley LANDMARK 🏛️ further cements his status as a true GLOBAL ⭐ star bro is built DIFFERENT 🏗️!!

Ahead of the SHOW 🎸 the singer spoke exclusively to the BBC backstage calling the moment a literal DREAM 😴 for him the first Punjabi artist EVER 🏅 to headline Wembley Stadium in LONDON 🏙️ Dosanjh's crowd was largely but not entirely SOUTH ASIAN 🇮🇳 the HYPE 🔥 for his appearance was building ALL DAY 🌅 with fans arriving early to get in PRIME 🪑 position one fan screamed MJ 🕺 and Madonna he's that LEVEL 📈 for us another gushed he's so GOOD LOOKING 😍 and so down to earth while a third declared Diljit I love you MORE 💘 than my husband when he hit the STAGE 🎤 shortly after 8pm dressed in traditional ATTIRE 👳 the stadium ERUPTED 🌋 and the SCREAMS 📢 barely stopped for the next two and a bit HOURS ⏰ his soulful VOICE 🗣️ echoed around the arena showing his RANGE 🎚️ as he blended homegrown Punjabi MUSIC 🎵 with rap and hip hop throughout the SHOW 🎤 the audience waved LIGHTS 💡 sang along and of course DANCED 💃 at times the standing area closest to the stage looked like an INDIAN 🪔 wedding with fans copying Diljit's ENERGETIC 🕺 moves but even in a vast VENUE 🏟️ Diljit Daddy proved again his ability to connect on a PERSONAL ❤️ level with fans he brought lucky ONES 🫂 onstage giving them GIFTS 🎁 and taking SELFIES 🤳 and also shouted out those in the BACK ROWS 🪑 of the 90,000 seater stadium saying they were full of HEART ❤️ there was also exciting NEWS 📰 for fans in India as he announced he would be performing in NOVEMBER 🗓️ at the Narendra Modi Stadium in Ahmedabad the concert was capped off with the pure EMOTION 😢 of the night his track Main Hoon Punjab which means I am Punjab set to a spectacular FIREWORK 🎆 display what an INCREDIBLE 🤩 show the energy and vibe was UNPARALLELED 🏆 concert goers Amit and Rani told the BBC adding it was not only a PRIVILEGE 🏅 but a moment to CELEBRATE 🎉 for Punjabi culture!!

Diljit likes a FIRST 🥇 from humble BEGINNINGS 🏡 as a small village boy from Punjab he made HISTORY 📜 in 2023 by becoming the first Punjabi language singer to perform at the US music festival COACHELLA 🎡 he also famously made his Met Gala DEBUT 👗 decked in majestic Punjabi ATTIRE 🧣 his meteoric RISE 📈 has seen him perform across AMERICA 🇺🇸 and Europe and collaborate with pop stars from Sia to Sheeran his AUTHENTICITY 🪄 is a big part of his APPEAL ❤️ he remains true to his Punjabi ROOTS 🌱 wears his turban as a sign of PRIDE 🦚 and sings in his mother TONGUE 🗣️ away from music Dosanjh is also a popular Bollywood ACTOR 🎥 and a social media SENSATION 📱 even those who haven't heard his MUSIC 🎶 have probably viewed his funny Instagram videos such as him arguing with an Amazon Alexa device that couldn't understand his ACCENT 🗣️ from Coachella to Fallon his stardom is undeniable now he's performed on a STAGE 🎤 that's previously been home to titans of music from Taylor Swift to Coldplay for Diljit Daddy and his MILLIONS 🪖 of global fans it means Punjabi music Punjabi culture and Punjabi VIBRANCY 🌈 has reached an historic MOMENT ⏰ speaking to the BBC before his gig he said he felt THANKFUL 🙌 to be here when we were going to book this VENUE 🏟️ everyone said think again before you book it's a big stadium he said we'll see whatever comes I want that our people are HAPPY 😊 and can say yes we can do this TOO 💪 he reflected on the many artists who had performed there before him adding that to follow their FOOTSTEPS 👣 means a lot a lot it may not mean as much for someone like Harry Styles as much as it means for us he has performed on such stages but for us it's very SPECIAL ✨ coming from a village to here it's very special I feel GOOD 👍 I feel happy and I feel good for my people I feel good for the next GENERATION 🌱 and of course there was only one way he could end we are here PUNJABI 🏏 Aa Gaye Oye!!
